resources.string: SELECT THIS NAME ON YOUR DEVICE
On your device, open Control Centre → Screen Mirroring.
Start the receiver when you are ready.
The receiver is on. Network visibility is not confirmed yet.
The TV and your device must share the same local network.
Try starting again. Open Help if the problem continues.
Audio service registration failed. You can retry from Help.
The phone disconnected. You can connect again.
The connection was reset. Try connecting again from your phone.
Pairing was cancelled and the receiver stopped.
Pairing timed out. Start the receiver to try again.
The network changed. Use Help to refresh visibility if needed.
Settings saved for the next receiver start
Applying changes asks for confirmation to stop the current stream.
Enter this code on the device you are connecting.
If pairing is not completed within two minutes, the receiver stops. Cancelling also stops it.
The current connection will end and the receiver will stop. Start it again to reconnect.
This stream is removed from the screen. The receiver stays on and remains visible in device lists.
The phone is connected. Preparing the picture; return to Help if it takes too long.
Start when I open the app
Be ready to connect when AirRelay opens.
Be ready in the background when the TV starts. Some TVs require additional permission.
Stay available while other apps are open.
TV name shown on your phone
Changing the name does not interrupt the current stream.
Use a shorter name. Names cannot be empty or start or end with spaces.
Verify a new connection with the code on your TV.
Devices on the same network may connect without entering a code. This takes effect when the receiver restarts.
Allow a new device to replace the stream
A new device connection ends the current stream.
Switch to full screen while the picture is being prepared.
Keep the screen on while connected
Prevent display sleep while a device is connected.
Turn off focus animations while keeping a clear focus outline.
Increase text size in addition to your system setting.
These settings can affect streaming. Changes apply only when the receiver restarts; the current stream is preserved.
Choose a topic for connection and playback help.
The TV is not listed on my device

Check that the TV and your device are on the same local network. Ethernet on the TV is fine. A guest network or device isolation may block discovery. Reopen Screen Mirroring on your device. If the receiver is on, announce it again below.
Pairing is stuck on the code screen
Enter the code in the prompt on your device, not with the TV remote. To cancel, choose Cancel; the receiver stops. Start it again for another attempt.
There is a picture but no sound
Check the volume on your device and TV. Make sure the content has sound and another output, such as Bluetooth headphones, is not selected.
Could not open network settings on this TV. Use the TV Settings screen.
Logs are size-limited and stored on this device. Sensitive fields are filtered. They contain no screenshots, video or audio recordings. Review before sharing.
A text file will be prepared and the TV share menu will open. Nothing is uploaded automatically. Your device may not have an app that can share it.
Could not save the log or open sharing. You can use the entries on this screen.
App logs and the prepared local sharing file will be deleted. Previously shared copies are not deleted.
Input statistics; not a display-frame-rate or latency measurement.
Complete initial setup from Connect before applying receiver settings.
